name: STRIVE-1
reference_standard: Consensus and measurement reliability rather than etiologic pathology
key_failure_mode: Phenotype terms may be misused as disease labels

name: STRIVE-2
intended_context: research description, acquisition, and emerging markers
target_construct: Visible and quantitative neuroimaging features of cSVD
key_failure_mode: Does not diagnose CAA or arteriolosclerosis

name: Boston criteria v2.0
intended_context: Estimate likelihood of sporadic CAA in adults >=50 with relevant clinical presentation
required_inputs: Clinical presentation, MRI hemorrhagic markers, absence of deep hemorrhagic lesions, selected WM features
validation_status: Validated in symptomatic temporal/geographic cohorts; lower performance in community/nonhemorrhagic samples
key_failure_mode: Spectrum dependence; mimics; sequence sensitivity; not population screening
clinical_status: Clinical and research classification with specialist interpretation

name: Edinburgh CT and genetic criteria
intended_context: Rule in/out CAA-associated lobar ICH when MRI is unavailable or not primary
target_construct: CAA as cause of lobar ICH
required_inputs: Acute CT morphology and APOE e4 genotype
validation_status: Internally validated; external validation still important
key_strength: Uses widely available acute CT features
key_failure_mode: Small derivation set; genotype availability; restricted to lobar ICH

name: Clinicoradiologic CAA-ri criteria
required_inputs: Subacute clinical syndrome, MRI edema/asymmetry and hemorrhagic evidence, exclusion of alternatives
key_failure_mode: Rare syndrome, mimics, verification and referral bias

name: Consensus CAA postmortem protocol
required_inputs: Specified brain regions and amyloid stains
key_failure_mode: Sampling still misses patchy lesions; interlaboratory variation

name: VCING
intended_context: Estimate likelihood that vascular pathology contributed to cognitive impairment
required_inputs: Standardized neuropathology including infarcts and vessel disease
key_strength: Forces integration of lesion burden and cognition
key_failure_mode: Not an antemortem etiologic diagnosis; incomplete for all mixed pathologies

name: Total SVD score
required_inputs: MRI ratings of lacunes, CMBs, WMH, and PVS

name: CAA-SVD score
target_construct: Visible MRI burden associated with CAA
key_failure_mode: Not a diagnostic rule; components overlap with non-CAA disease

name: MARS
intended_context: Standardize cerebral microbleed detection and location
key_failure_mode: Sequence and mimic sensitivity; labor intensive

name: BOMBS
target_construct: CMB presence, certainty, location, and mimics
key_failure_mode: Still dependent on reader and acquisition

name: ARTS
required_inputs: T1 MRI, FLAIR/WMH, diffusion FA, age, sex, container prerequisites
validation_status: Pathology-linked development/test; strong reported repeatability; transportability incomplete
reference_standard: Semiquantitative autopsy arteriolosclerosis for original diagnostic test
key_strength: First openly available automated pathology-linked B-ASC score
key_failure_mode: Older selected cohorts; MRI-death interval; no clinical cutoff; score is not pathology
version_or_access: NITRC ARTS container; record version in every analysis

name: PSMD
target_construct: Peak width of skeletonized mean diffusivity
key_failure_mode: Not etiologically specific; acquisition and processing dependence

name: White-matter free water
key_failure_mode: Model and motion dependence; nonspecific biology

name: WMH segmentation algorithms
intended_context: Quantify WMH volume and spatial distribution
required_inputs: FLAIR plus optional T1; algorithm-specific preprocessing
validation_status: Benchmark performance exists; external transport varies
key_failure_mode: Domain shift, lesion mimics, scanner effects, opaque QC
clinical_status: Research; clinical use depends on product
version_or_access: Record model, weights, threshold, and QC

name: Digital histopathology CNN marker suite
intended_context: Quantify vascular amyloid, plaques, iron/calcium, glia, and fibrin
required_inputs: Digitized stained slides and trained Aiforia models
key_failure_mode: Laboratory/stain/platform domain shift; external validation limited

name: Carbon-dioxide challenge cerebrovascular reactivity MRI
intended_context: research measurement of vascular reserve and dysfunction
target_construct: Change in cerebral MRI signal or flow response to a vasoactive challenge
required_inputs: Standardized BOLD or perfusion MRI, gas delivery/end-tidal monitoring, preprocessing, region definition
output: Regional or voxelwise CVR magnitude and related parameters
development_or_authority: MarkVCID and other SVD research programs
validation_status: Multisite cognitive association and longitudinal imaging prediction; pathology specificity untested
reference_standard: Reproducibility, cognition, and longitudinal SVD imaging rather than vessel pathology
key_strength: Measures vascular function before irreversible structural injury
key_failure_mode: Gas challenge, analysis, motion, vascular anatomy, and systemic physiology reduce scalability and specificity

name: Regional amyloid PET pattern analysis
intended_context: research differential assessment of CAA, AD, and controls
target_construct: Global and regional fibrillar amyloid tracer retention
required_inputs: Amyloid PET, tracer-specific processing, reference region, structural imaging, prespecified regional ratios
output: Global uptake and regional distribution metrics
validation_status: Group-level differences; no universal pathology-validated patient threshold
reference_standard: Usually clinical CAA/AD classifications; sparse pathology
key_strength: Directly probes fibrillar amyloid distribution in vivo
key_failure_mode: Cannot reliably assign vascular versus parenchymal amyloid in mixed disease
clinical_status: Research adjunct; not standalone CAA diagnosis

name: ARIA detection and monitoring framework
target_construct: ARIA-E edema/effusion and ARIA-H hemorrhagic abnormalities
required_inputs: Baseline and serial FLAIR, diffusion, T2*-GRE or SWI, clinical context, treatment timing
output: Presence, type, severity, evolution, and action-relevant communication
development_or_authority: Alzheimer's Association workgroup and neuroradiology guidance
validation_status: Consensus-based monitoring with therapy-specific evidence; real-world severe-event prediction remains limited
reference_standard: Trial and clinical imaging definitions plus outcomes
key_strength: Connects standardized detection to safety workflows
key_failure_mode: ARIA, spontaneous CAA-ri, infarction, PRES, infection, and other mimics may overlap
clinical_status: Clinical safety framework; use current drug-specific guidance
